title: Retire the old launch doors while preserving their routes and attribution

source.ref: Daniel-approved Gate A retirement plan, 2026-11-11; coordination claim on #4306 reserves LIVE-2262 for codex/gate-a-retired-doors.

detail: The retired /go campaign doors, /free-spotlight landing, Vera /spaces/launch drafter, and /start/[flow] splash must stop rendering while their old links keep reaching the right survivor through permanent 308 redirects. Keep /start/host live for invite attribution. Next.js config redirects run before filesystem routes, use 308 when permanent:true, and carry incoming query parameters through, including UTM and gclid values (Next 16 redirecting and redirects config docs). Daniel explicitly approved re-aiming only LIVE-1969, LIVE-1629, and LIVE-2158 on 2026-11-11. Their probes now verify the permanent /go survivor map, the /free-spotlight to /create-a-space campaign redirect, and the /spaces/launch plus legacy /start redirects while retaining checks for surviving funnel layouts. No other probes were changed. The row probe and the three re-aimed probes pass locally. Keep this row open until the exact-head checks and preview behavior provide the remaining acceptance evidence. LIVE-962 is not a fourth probe blocker: the git ls-files check passes when staged deletions are represented in the branch index.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const c=fs.readFileSync("next.config.ts","utf8");const q=String.fromCharCode(39);const pairs=[["/go/calm-down-fast","/mindless"],["/go/find-your-people","/events"],["/go/host-one-circle","/create-a-space"],["/go/bring-your-practice","/create-a-space"],["/go/run-it-together","/create-a-space"],["/go/:path*","/create-a-space"],["/free-spotlight","/create-a-space?utm_campaign=free-spotlight"],["/spaces/launch","/create-a-space"],["/start/welcome","/join"],["/start/event","/join"],["/start/partner","/start/host"]];const bad=[];for(const [a,b] of pairs)if(!c.includes("{ source: "+q+a+q+", destination: "+q+b+q+", permanent: true }"))bad.push(a+" must permanently redirect to "+b);for(const p of ["app/(marketing)/go/[door]/page.tsx","app/(marketing)/free-spotlight/page.tsx","app/(main)/spaces/launch/page.tsx","app/(marketing)/start/[flow]/page.tsx"])if(fs.existsSync(p))bad.push(p+" still exists");if(!fs.existsSync("app/(marketing)/start/host/page.tsx"))bad.push("/start/host is missing");const protectedProbes=[["LIVE-1969","scripts/probes/create-space-doors.mjs","lib/marketing/launch-doors.ts"],["LIVE-1629","scripts/probes/free-spotlight-entry.mjs","app/(marketing)/free-spotlight/page.tsx"],["LIVE-2158","scripts/probes/marketing-evolution-funnels.mjs","launch/free-spotlight.tsx"]];for(const [id,path,stale] of protectedProbes)if(fs.existsSync(path)&&fs.readFileSync(path,"utf8").includes(stale))bad.push("needs-Daniel: protected probe "+id+" still names retired path "+stale);if(bad.length){console.error("LIVE-2262: "+bad.join(String.fromCharCode(10)));process.exit(1)}console.log("LIVE-2262: retired launch routes stay gone and redirects are permanent; protected probes no longer contain stale paths")'
verify.note: The row probe checks exact permanent redirect mappings, absence of retired route files, and preservation of /start/host. The three closed protected probes were re-aimed only with Daniel’s explicit item-specific approval; each retains its surviving acceptance checks. Keep the row open until exact-head CI and preview behavior are confirmed.
